name: Wanjiru
self_text: I am a Canadian man in my mid 30s who loves watching old westerns. I use a phone for my photography. I am looking for a practice session working on specific shots at a fast pace. I want someone to teach me post-processing. I am available weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available weekday evenings and you have to be the one who teaches me post-processing. It is a deal-breaker unless you are into a practice session working on specific shots or a relaxed photo walk. Ideally, you are okay with a moderate pace or a fast pace, but no big deal.
